messages:
priya: Quick sync — product asks to prioritize a dedicated-capacity roadmap slice: per-tenant soft/hard quotas + scheduling policy to protect 99th% latency. Need tradeoffs + launch checklist. Who's owning?

sam: I'm happy to own the scheduling algo work. Quick Q: do we prefer tenant isolation (hard partitions) or proportional soft quotas + throttling?

katie: Customers keep asking for hard guarantees for compliance. But hard partitions increase cost. My proposal: soft quotas with guaranteed minimum headroom + optional hard caps as paid feature.

jordan: Agree w/ katie. We should define launch tiers: "Guaranteed" (hard cap + reserved pool), "Committed" (soft quota + priority), "BestEffort" (no SLA).

priya: +1. Need measurable launch criteria: 99th latency under 500ms for small models, 95th under 1s for large; cost delta <15% vs baseline; automatic fallback path to lower-cost model variants when capacity tight.

alex: For autoscale policy: prefer predictive scale-up on sustained rate over 30s + immediate emergency burst for 5s when headroom available. Also add cooldowns. Example config: 
```
{"policy":"predictive","window_s":30,"burst_grace_s":5,"cooldown_s":60}
```

ops-bot: deploy-checker: load-test results required before canary.

sam: Implementation notes — scheduler needs tenant_score = min(1, usage/soft_quota) and preempt if tenant_score>1. We'll add preempt-safe flag for latency-critical queries so they skip preemption.

katie: Need SLO docs + billing impact note for sales. I'll draft the customer-facing tiers and pricing delta.

priya: Action items: sam -> scheduling RFC by EOW, katie -> customer-facing tiers doc, jordan -> metrics dashboard mockups, alex -> autoscale config test plan. Tagging @eng-sre for disaster scenarios.

maria: FYI — one large customer asked for per-tenant quotas + burst credits. Recommend we include a beta opt-in with telemetry hooks so we can tune defaults.

priya: OK — sounds like a plan. We should surface a short decision doc for execs listing cost tradeoffs and recommended default values.

sam: I'll include simulation numbers (p50/p95/p99 latency under mixed workloads) in the RFC.

katie: Thanks — if we can get the RFC + tiers doc by Friday we can align roadmap and tell sales what to promise.

priya: Cool. Closing thread for now, reopen if blockers. :rocket:
